chunks: Say: Obey God and obey the Apostle. If they turn away, then upon him is that which was entrusted to him, and upon you is that which you were entrusted with; and if you obey him you will be guided. And the duty of the Messenger is only clear conveyance.
ai.seo_question: What is the Messenger's duty if people turn away from obedience?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inseparable link between divine obedience and prophetic authority, often cited to validate the Imamate as the continuation of the Messenger's role. It clarifies that while the Prophet's duty was clear conveyance (balaagh), the believers' accountability for deviation rests solely on their own choices, highlighting the principle of individual responsibility within the framework of following the Ahl al-Bayt.
